evidence: Single package (DrissionPage) with no inter-service communication patterns
High cohesion within modules (e.g., _units contains behavior-related classes like Actions, Clicker, Waiter)
Low coupling via explicit imports and dependency injection (e.g., classes import from relative paths within same package)
No external service dependencies or network protocols in core code
Repository structure shows hierarchical organization with deep directory nesting (max_depth=3) typical of well-organized monoliths
Average fan-out of ~4.8 indicates moderate inter-module dependencies consistent with modular monoliths
Multiple page types (ChromiumPage, SessionPage, WebPage, MixTab) share common base classes, indicating inheritance-based modularity
risks: Tight coupling between _pages and _units modules could hinder future scalability
Shared state in _configs and _functions may create hidden dependencies
